title: MasterChef Junior - Best Molten Lava Cake
description: Luyện nghe qua đoạn hội thoại trong chương trình MasterChef Junior với Sarah (9 tuổi) và giám khảo Gordon Ramsay.
transcript:
Here we have a molten lava cake with glazed raspberries and a raspberry and orange juice sauce. Sarah, I think that you have ___nailed___ it. This is probably the best molten lava cake that we've had in MasterChef, and you're 9 years old. Thank you, Chef.

I'm hoping for there not to be like cabbage or ___liver___. I don't like cooking ___organs___.

Your next cooking challenge is desserts: cake, chocolate ___fountain___, cupcake. We want you guys to each make us one amazing dessert that any of us three could put in one of our ___restaurants___.

Here we go. This is where you can really be ___creative___, but also it takes so much ___skill___, right? Sarah, how you feeling? Good!

Why molten lava cake, the most ___difficult___ dessert to pull off in a restaurant? Because I think that'll ___impress___ you if I get it right.

Two minutes to go, everybody got to start ___decorating___. Look at the ___determination___ on their faces. Extraordinary!

I'm kind of ___nervous___ because I think my lava cake turned out. So kind of ___running___ out? Yes, like lava! Yes, this is what we call the ___moment___ of truth.

Everything was tasting so much creativity going on, flavors, ___textures___. No, all of you, great job!

It would help me save up for ___culinary___ school and for my restaurant.

You guys did yourselves ___proud___. You three are ___moving___ on to the next round. I'm really ___psyched___ that I'm in the top 12. ___Watch___ out Gordon, just wait until you see my next dish!

mcqQuestions.q: What does Gordon Ramsay mean when he tells Sarah: 'I think that you have nailed it'?
options: Sarah executed and finished the dish perfectly.
Sarah needs to fix the cake with tools.

mcqQuestions.q: What does 'pull off' mean in 'the most difficult dessert to pull off'?
options: To remove from the oven quickly.

mcqQuestions.q: What does Sarah mean: 'I think that'll impress you if I get it right'?
options: She wants to pressure the judges.
She believes it will make a strong positive impression.
She wants to confuse the judges.

mcqQuestions.q: What does 'The Moment of Truth' refer to?
options: The critical moment when cutting the cake reveals if it was cooked correctly.

mcqQuestions.q: What attitude does 'I'm not going to stop cooking. You'll see me again' express?
